meta.title: Dog grooming prices in Hall Green | Keith's K9 Care
meta.description: Full published price guide with breed examples - small dogs from £40, medium from £50, large or doodles from £60 for a full groom. Hall Green, Wakefield WF4.

hero.heading: Clear pricing, no surprises.
hero.body: I'm proud to publish my prices upfront. Competitive rates, no hidden fees, and I always confirm the final price before we start.

addOns.label: Anxious / nervous handling allowance
addOns.note: up to +£20 depending on time taken

addOns.label: Extra time for heavy coats or long gaps between grooms

addOnsIntro.heading: Anything extra is added honestly.
addOnsIntro.description: If a coat needs more time than the standard tier, we'll say so up-front. Nothing's a surprise on the bill.

cards.b: After meeting your dog and assessing the coat, Keith will confirm the price before the bath begins. No surprises after.
Two cockapoos can be £20 apart — one might be a tangle, one might be perfect. We price the work, not the diary slot.
If a severely matted coat can't be saved kindly, a clip-down is cheaper than de-matting and better for your dog. We'll always tell you.

contactCta.heading: Got a breed or coat we haven't listed?
contactCta.body: Send Keith a quick photo and he'll give you a proper price estimate before you book.
